hypotheses.title: Intraday Bar Direction Mean Reversion (Decay 10 Setting Optimization)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 177, this exact formula delivered 6 PASS with Sharpe 1.38, Sub-universe Sharpe 0.97, and ZERO self-correlation warnings. The only hurdle was Fitness (0.83 vs 1.00) due to 27.59% turnover under decay 5. Increasing simulation decay from 5 to 10 applies a 10-day portfolio holding smoothing, halving turnover to ~12%-14% and mathematically projecting Fitness to >= 1.25.
confounders: Strong multi-day momentum breakouts supported by institutional block buying
Pre-market earnings gaps that dictate entire day-to-day returns
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive multi-day trend rallies where opening prints mark the intraday lows consistently.

hypotheses.title: Intraday Bar Direction Mean Reversion (18-Day Formula Decay)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Extending the inner linear decay window from 10 to 18 trading days smooths the intraday pressure signal directly at the formula level. This compresses daily portfolio turnover from 27.59% down to ~12% under standard decay 5 settings, driving Fitness above 1.20 while preserving Sharpe >= 1.30.
confounders: Lagged signal responsiveness during sudden regime shifts from mean-reversion to momentum
Extended low volatility periods blunting intraday bar range
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden momentum trend acceleration where 18-day smoothed reversion signals remain positioned counter-trend.

hypotheses.title: VWAP Range-Normalized Mean Reversion (18-Day Formula Decay)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 177, VWAP mean reversion delivered Sharpe 1.35 and Sub-universe Sharpe 0.92 with 6 PASS. Extending the decay smoothing to 18 days dampens daily turnover from 27.20% down to ~12%, boosting Fitness from 0.67 to >= 1.15 without self-correlation collisions.
confounders: Persistent institutional block selling below VWAP during quarterly rebalancing cycles
Extended single-direction trend days overriding volume-weighted mean reversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during macro panic liquidity sell-offs where price remains pinned below VWAP for weeks.
